## Our journey

### 2013

Departing Oracle, Incorta’s founders create the first prototypes for the Incorta Platform and Direct Data Mapping®.

### 2015

Incorta raises $25M from GV, Kleiner Perkins, M12, Telstra Ventures and Ron Wohl.

### 2017

Founders raise seed funding to develop the first commercial version of the Incorta platform and hire its first employees. Incorta lands its first three customers: Broadcom, Stanford University and a Fortune 500 Consumer Technology company.

### 2019

Incorta raises $30M Series C funding, led by Sorenson Capital and Wipro Ventures.

### 2021

Scott Jones joins Incorta as CEO and Rob Dillon as CFO, along with 200+ new hires, as the company expands globally. Incorta raises $120M Series D funding, led by Prysm Capital.

### 2022

Incorta recognized for the first time in the 2022 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Analytics and BI Platforms as well as a Best Workplace by Inc. Magazine.

## **Our values**

### THINK: How does your mind work?

We’re wired to think deeply - about our customers, our impact, and how we can drive meaningful innovation.

![Three stylized figures holding hands in a circle representing diversity and unity.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67b7abfbb037e687d0a415ec/67e69dda5593f3ae18626db6_diversity_2_40dp_FFFFFF_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz40.svg)

### **ACT: How do you respond to your environment?**

We act like leaders: with intention, with respect, and with passion.

![Simple white user profile icon with head and shoulders.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67b7abfbb037e687d0a415ec/67e69eafaad6f221f76a5ec9_account_circle_40dp_4854FE_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz40.svg)

### **BE: Who are you?**

We are inclusive. We are present. We are authentic. We are ONE team.

We are Incorta.

![Blue outline icon of two hands shaking, symbolizing agreement or partnership.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67b7abfbb037e687d0a415ec/67e69e80df9d6be9c84469bc_handshake_40dp_FFFFFF_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz40.svg)

### **LOVE: What matters to you?**

We love our families, our customers, our community, our teams, and most importantly: we love who we are and what we do.
